capabilities: Toggle math between inline and display block styles
Merge consecutive block formulas into an aligned block
Convert the selection, cursor block, or current line
Show conversion actions in the editor context menu
extras: Installation is manual sideloading from release files. The README includes migration instructions because the plugin ID was renamed from obisian-latex-inline-block-toggle, requiring users to reassign custom hotkeys and not enable both copies. Documented limitations: no full LaTeX parser, no fenced ```math block support, and currency false positives are only partly handled.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to switch a math expression between inline and block delimiters or to combine adjacent display formulas into one block.
summary: Editor commands and context-menu actions that convert LaTeX math between inline $...$ and display $$...$$ styles and merge consecutive display blocks.
